capabilities: render text in ugougo code blocks as wobbling animated SVG graphics
customize color, stroke, size, wobble, frequency, fps, font and alignment per block
insert ugougo block templates from the command palette
export notes as Marp HTML slides with the same rendering
respect the OS reduced-motion setting and offer static rendering
extras: Not in the community plugin store; manual installation after building with Node.js is required. Unofficial fan project explicitly unaffiliated with Fuji TV; text is rendered one glyph per SVG element, so copying as words is harder.
problem: Obsidian renders text statically, so playful animated hand-drawn-style typography cannot appear in notes from plain Markdown.

relations.plugin: ウゴウゴルーガ (Ugougo Ruga TV show)

relations.evidence: Marp CLI のカスタムエンジンを同梱しています

summary: Code block renderer that draws text inside ugougo fences as wobbling retro-TV-style animated SVG graphics, also usable in Marp slides and VS Code preview.
